qa_pair.question: Using tools/list, find the tool that updates an existing opportunity (PUT /opportunities/{id}). How many properties does its body schema expose, counting them from the inputSchema? List is: pipelineId, name, pipelineStageId, status, monetaryValue, forecastExpectedCloseDate, forecastProbability, assignedTo, customFields — the answer is the count.

What Version header value does the tool for listing calendar resources (GET /calendars/resources/{resourceType}, tool ghl_calendar_resource_list) send? (This is the case where the v3-tier spec variant is deprecated and the legacy header is correct.)
What Version header value does ghl_calendar_list_free_slots (GET /calendars/{calendarId}/free-slots) send?

Per the inputSchema of ghl_media_list_files (GET /medias/files), how many parameters are required, and is `type` one of them? Answer as ", yes|no". (The old connector 422'd on this endpoint because it couldn't pass `type` at all.)
Does the inputSchema of ghl_opportunity_search (GET /opportunities/search) expose both genuine GHL cursor parameters startAfter and startAfterId? Answer yes or no.
According to the body schema of the contact-task creation tool (POST /contacts/{contactId}/tasks), which three body fields are required? Answer as a comma-separated list in schema order.
How many body properties does ghl_contact_update (PUT /contacts/{contactId}) expose? (The old connector exposed only 5 of them: company, email, firstName, lastName, phone.)
What request content type does the server use for ghl_oauth_get_access_token (POST /oauth/token)?
What request content type does ghl_conversation_upload_file_attachments (POST /conversations/messages/upload) use?
With no domain filter set, how many tools does the server register, and how many operations are skipped as curated exceptions? Answer as "registered, skipped".
